description: Resize, compress, convert (jpeg, png, webp), strip metadata (EXIF, GPS, XMP) or remove the background from an image. Reads HEIC. strip_metadata never re-encodes pixels. remove_background downloads a 4.4MB model once per machine and always writes PNG. Returns the real output dimensions and byte size.

background.description: remove_background: fill colour behind the subject, for example #ffffff. Default transparent

format.description: convert: target format. Others: default keeps the source format, HEIC becomes jpeg

path.description: Absolute path of the source image. Relative paths are refused

width.description: resize: give width or height alone to keep the aspect ratio

name: image_edit
title: Edit image
